Claim 1 (Currently amended): An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device is integrated with a physical device enabling real-time interaction with the documented procedure.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and using said alignment to provide feedback to a user engaging with the documented procedure in real-time.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in dynamically highlighting the current step on the user interface during user interaction.
